area_definition: Toronto (CMA), Ont. - 2021 Census metropolitan area (place of residence)
measure: Employment income of full-year full-time workers aged 15+ (median, annual, before tax)
notes: Median and employment = Statistics Canada 2021 Census table 98-10-0452-01 (Total occupation; work activity 'Worked full year, full time'; total age 15+; total gender; persons in private households with employment income in 2020; includes employees and self-employed; 25% long-form sample; counts randomly rounded). P10/P25/P75/P90 are NOT published: computed by linear interpolation within income brackets of table 98-10-0596-01 (same CMA, 'Worked full year, full time', total occupation), whose brackets are for LABOUR MARKET RELATED INCOME (employment income + EI/COVID benefits), not employment income alone; brackets $5k wide to $50k, $10k to $100k, then $100k-149,999 and $150k+; 'Under $5,000' includes losses and was treated as 0-5,000. Cross-check: published LMRI median 69500 vs interpolated LMRI P50 69679 vs published employment-income median 69500. Paid employees only (98-10-0598-01, class of worker 'Employee', FYFT): median 71500, n=1533945. Income year 2020 (COVID-affected). P75/P90 above $100k lie in the wide $100,000-149,999 bracket, so they are rough. Percentile table 98-10-0596-01: https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=9810059601 ; employee-only table 98-10-0598-01: https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=9810059801
